disclaimer: Curated notes are not medical advice. Safety tiers describe kitchen mechanism, not a guarantee. Always verify with the restaurant before dining. Cross-check Find Me Gluten Free for high-stakes celiac decisions. Re-verify periodically — dedicated spots close and protocols change.

places.name: Foo Dog Curry Traders
places.allergy_safety_note: Dedicated gluten-free Asian fusion — entire menu is GF (from-scratch curries). Strong Riverside pick for celiac. Confirm dairy/nut needs with staff.

places.name: Kathy's Table
places.allergy_safety_note: Gluten-free meal prep / retail in Five Points — dedicated GF kitchen ethos for prepared meals and juices. Confirm other allergens on the rotating menu.

places.name: Sassy Kat Goods
places.allergy_safety_note: Dedicated gluten-free cottage bakery (Mandarin bake stand, honor-system Fri–Sun). Pre-order recommended. Ask about dairy/nut products day-of.

places.name: Everything But The Gluten
places.allergy_safety_note: 100% gluten-free small-batch bakery (order/pickup model — not a walk-in café). Confirm pickup logistics and dairy/nut handling when ordering.

places.name: Sweet Theory Baking Co.
places.allergy_safety_note: Popular GF/vegan-friendly bakery with strong celiac community praise — NOT a fully dedicated wheat-free facility. Confirm prep and cross-contact for hyper-sensitive celiac.

places.name: Bartaco
places.allergy_safety_note: Corn-tortilla taco concept with allergy-aware national protocols. Shared kitchen — not dedicated. Disclose peanut/tree-nut and gluten needs.

places.name: Chipotle Mexican Grill
places.allergy_safety_note: Corporate allergen statement: peanuts and tree nuts are not used as ingredients. Shared line / cross-contact still possible — tell the crew. Not a medical guarantee.

places.name: Rodrigo's Craft Pizza
places.allergy_safety_note: Frequently cited for GF pizza options in Jax. Shared kitchen — confirm dedicated prep protocols and flour handling if highly sensitive.

places.name: V Pizza & Sidecar
places.allergy_safety_note: San Marco location often noted for GF crust options. Shared kitchen — verify prep and toppings for celiac.

places.name: Arepa Please
places.allergy_safety_note: Corn arepas are naturally wheat-light for many GF diners. Shared prep — confirm fillings, fryers, and sauces. Not dedicated.

places.name: Indochine
places.allergy_safety_note: Vietnamese menu with GF-friendly rice-noodle options when staff are told. Peanut sauces are common — disclose nut allergies. Shared kitchen.

places.name: Blueberry Artisan Bakery & Cafe
places.allergy_safety_note: Offers GF bakery/café items — shared facility with wheat. Confirm dedicated prep for celiac; better for preference than hyper-sensitive needs.

places.name: Southern Grounds & Co.
places.allergy_safety_note: Café with plant-milk and some GF items. Not an allergy kitchen — ask about steamer cross-contact and bakery case wheat.

places.name: Taqueria Cinco
places.allergy_safety_note: Corn tortillas help many GF diners. Busy shared kitchen — verify sauces and fryers. Not dedicated.
